heading: OUR CONSUMER SURVEY · 3–9 OCT 2026
panel_lines: 49 consenting adults from 50 Google Form submissions
18 of 22 water-source changers reported worse hair problems (81.8%)
38 of 49 rated the concept 4 or 5 out of 5 (77.6%)
Median maximum price for 340 ml: Tk 320 (n=47)
15 of 47 stated a maximum price of at least Tk 360 (31.9%)
Convenience sample; self-reports. Water/foam tests remain planned.
appendix_consumer_text: Khanam & Rahman 2022 (n=390); Zakaria et al. 2025 (n=391); team Google Form, 3–9 Oct 2026: 49 consenting adults from 50 submissions, convenience sample. Q20: median maximum Tk 320 (n=47); 15/47 maxima at least Tk 360.
source_footer_addition: Team Google Form survey, 3–9 Oct 2026 (n=49; maximum-price answers n=47).
speaker_note: Own survey results are self-reported from a convenience sample. Percentages show their actual bases. The Tk 360 figure is the proposed price and a threshold applied to Q20 recorded maximum acceptable prices; it is not observed purchase conversion. Collection channel was not recorded per respondent, so no invented online/offline distribution is shown. Product, water and foam testing remain pending. Published studies remain attributed to their authors.
collection_distribution_status: Not recorded per respondent; imagined allocations are not survey evidence.
